displayName: OCI-MOB-003: Mobile — Hardcoded Credentials in Binary
description:
Detects hardcoded credentials, API keys, or tokens in mobile app binaries or configuration files

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_mob_003", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%mobile%' AND "value" > 0
